lesson_title: Spring Boot Fundamentals and Project Setup
lesson_description: In this lesson, students will gain a foundational understanding of Spring Boot, including its purpose, key features, and how to set up a basic Spring Boot project. Students will also explore the Spring Boot CLI and learn how to create a new Spring Boot application, laying the groundwork for more advanced full-stack Spring Boot development.

subtopics.title: Understanding Spring Boot and Its Purpose
subtopics.description: This subtopic introduces students to the concept of Spring Boot, explaining its purpose in simplifying the setup and configuration of Spring applications. It covers key features such as auto-configuration, embedded servers, and how it streamlines the development process. The description will include examples and real-world applications to illustrate these concepts.

subtopics.title: Setting Up a Basic Spring Boot Project
subtopics.description: In this subtopic, students will learn how to create a basic Spring Boot project using the Spring Initializr and the Spring Boot CLI. They will explore the process of configuring dependencies, setting up a controller, and creating a simple RESTful API. The description will include step-by-step instructions and code snippets.

subtopics.title: Exploring the Spring Boot CLI and Its Commands
subtopics.description: This subtopic delves into the Spring Boot CLI, explaining its commands and how to use them to manage Spring Boot projects. Students will learn about commands for creating new projects, running applications, and deploying applications. The description will include examples and practical exercises to ensure students are comfortable using the CLI.
